about_the_game:
Overcome Your Fears is a psychological atmospheric horror game that immerses you in a world of the unknown.

You are exploring the story of 19-year-old Steve Jackson, who is tasked with house-sitting for his friends in a small town.

In this game, you play as Steve Jackson, a 19-year-old who takes a job house-sitting for friends while they are on vacation. What starts as a simple favor quickly turns into a chilling experience as unsettling events unfold in the quiet town. Little does Steve know, that these days will reveal dark secrets, and he must make choices that will change everything.

The Gameplay

This game primarily features a first-person narrative walking simulator with exploration and interaction mechanics.

                         

Key Features

  • Atmospheric environment and realistic graphics.

  • Psychological horror elements with unexpected twists.

  • VHS film aesthetic.

  • Interactive dialogues with NPCs.

  • Player voice activity

  • Unique sound effects that create tension.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 | AMD FX-6350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670 | AMD Ryzen5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660Ti 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11

short_description: Steve Jackson, an 19 year old highschooler is house-sitting for friends when he encounters eerie events in a small town. Dive into a psychological horror where shadows conceal secrets. Can you uncover the truth before it's too late?
